rsnt-01-c1.text: Catholic Encyclopedia (1913) (1913). Pope John XV (XVI). Catholic Answers, Catholic Encyclopedia.
rsnt-01-c1.quote: This was the first time that a solemn canonization had been made by a pope.
rsnt-01-c1.claim: The first securely documented papal canonization is that of Ulrich, bishop of Augsburg, by Pope John XV in 993.

rsnt-01-c2.text: Congregation for the Causes of Saints. History of the Congregation for the Causes of Saints. The Holy See (vatican.va).
rsnt-01-c2.quote: Sixtus V created the Sacred Congregation of Rites
rsnt-01-c2.claim: In 1588 Pope Sixtus V reorganized the Roman Curia with the bull Immensa Aeterni Dei and created the Sacred Congregation of Rites
